questions.explanation: 左端の第一印象を否定→次に→赤ちゃんを抱いている人と特定。2024年問9型（写真の中の人物特定 ）。
questions.imagePrompt: Black and white line-art illustration for a listening test. ONE single drawing of a school shoe-locker wall with columns labeled A, B, C and numbered rows. FOUR circled numbers 1-4 placed INSIDE the picture on four different lockers: 1 column B second row from top left side, 2 column B third row from top left side, 3 column B third row from top right side, 4 column A third row from top right side. Grayscale cartoon, no color, no other text.

questions.scene: 男女が空港で荷物を預ける手続きをしている。
options: 大きなスーツケース1つ
大きなスーツケースとリュックの2つ
キャリーオンとリュック

turns.text: I have one large suitcase and this small carry-on.
Only the large one goes to check-in. The carry-on stays with you.
And this backpack?
Backpack too, if it fits under the seat.

questions.question: Which is checked in (預け入れ) ?
questions.answerText: 大きなスーツケース1つ
questions.explanation: 預け入れ／機内持ち込みの区別。large one goes to check-in が核心。他は機内持ち込み。
questions.imagePrompt: Black and white line-art illustration sheet for a listening test. A 2x2 grid of four equal square panels, thin gray borders, large circled numbers 1 2 3 4 at top-left of each panel, plain white background, grayscale only, clean cartoon line drawing, no color, no other text. Each panel shows an airport check-in counter with a conveyor belt receiving specific bags. Panel 1: only a LARGE suitcase on the belt going to check-in, a small carry-on and a backpack stay with the passenger. Panel 2: a large suitcase AND a backpack on the belt. Panel 3: a carry-on AND a backpack on the belt. Panel 4: all three items (large suitcase, carry-on, backpack) on the belt.

questions.scene: 男女がケーキ屋でギフト用のケーキを選んでいる。

turns.text: We have chocolate, strawberry, and cheesecake.
She loves fruits, but not strawberries. Actually, she's allergic to them.
How about our peach cake, then?
Perfect. I'll take that.

questions.question: Which cake will the man buy?
questions.answerText: 桃のケーキ
questions.explanation: 「フルーツは好きだが苺はアレルギー」の情報から桃を新たに提案。3択→アレルギー→新提案の流 れ。
questions.imagePrompt: Black and white line-art illustration sheet for a listening test. A 2x2 grid of four equal square panels, thin gray borders, large circled numbers 1 2 3 4 at top-left of each panel, plain white background, grayscale only, clean cartoon line drawing, no color, no other text. Each panel shows a whole cake on a plate with fruit/topping identifiable. Panel 1: chocolate cake with chocolate curls on top. Panel 2: strawberry shortcake with whole strawberries on top. Panel 3: cheesecake (plain, smooth top). Panel 4: cake topped with peach slices.

questions.scene: 男女が学校の靴箱の位置を確認している。

turns.text: Could you put my gym bag in my shoe locker?
Sure. It's in row B, second from the top, isn't it?
It used to be, but they moved me to row C.
Row C. Which one?
Third from the top.

questions.question: Which locker is the man's?
questions.answerText: C列 上から3段目
questions.explanation: 女性の思い込み（row B, second from the top）を they moved me to row C が訂正し、Third from the top で段が確定する。列の訂正と段の指定を2段階で追う。①は訂正される前の位置、②は段だけ合っていて列が古い、④は列が違う。
questions.imagePrompt: Black and white line-art illustration sheet for a listening test. A 2x2 grid of four equal square panels, thin gray borders, large circled numbers 1 2 3 4 at top-left of each panel, plain white background, grayscale only, clean cartoon line drawing, no color, no other text. Each panel shows a grid of shoe lockers labeled A, B, C columns and numbered rows, with one specific locker highlighted. Panel 1: column B, second row from top, left-side locker highlighted. Panel 2: column B, third row from top, left-side locker highlighted. Panel 3: column B, third row from top, right-side locker highlighted. Panel 4: column A, third row from top, right-side locker highlighted.

questions.scene: 男女がスポーツ用品店でテニスラケットを選んでいる。
options: 重量級・ヘッド大きめ
重量級・ヘッド小さめ

turns.text: I'm a beginner. Which racket do you recommend?
This lightweight one is good for beginners. It has a larger head.
And the color?
Available in blue, black, or white.

questions.question: Which racket will the woman likely choose (based on the recommended features)?
questions.answerText: 軽量・ヘッド大きめ
questions.explanation: 色は「どれでもよい」ため無関係。lightweight + larger head の2条件で決定。属性の掛け合わせ。
questions.imagePrompt: Black and white line-art illustration sheet for a listening test. A 2x2 grid of four equal square panels, thin gray borders, large circled numbers 1 2 3 4 at top-left of each panel, plain white background, grayscale only, clean cartoon line drawing, no color, no other text. Each panel shows a tennis racket with a small label for weight and head size. Panel 1: racket with a LARGE oval head, label 'LIGHT'. Panel 2: racket with a large head, label 'HEAVY'. Panel 3: racket with a SMALL head, label 'LIGHT'. Panel 4: racket with a small head, label 'HEAVY'.
